title: Test protocols: dynamic drop and sled tests (T-D1 to T-D5)
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Dynamic tests decide the ride rating matrix. They need ATD selection, pulse definitions, instrumentation and matrices. Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Write test protocols for T-D1–T-D5: rig descriptions, ATD choice and instrumentation (e.g., THOR abdomen), pulse definitions per ride class, test matrix (including Integrated Harness and center-strap modes), data processing and pass criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: Test matrix covers every configuration named in the test plan
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
